data.summary: Reviews appear authentic and paint a coherent picture of a company with significant quality control and customer service issues, particularly in routine maintenance. Positive reviews are detailed and reference long-term reliability for repairs and remodels. Negative reviews are highly specific, emotionally charged, and describe consistent failure patterns (pools turning green, unresponsiveness). The lack of BBB profile and minimal online presence is a minor concern but not unusual for a small local contractor.

negative_evidence: Charged for work that did not fix the problem (Brenda's review)
Lack of responsibility for pool maintenance failures (Bart's review)
positive_evidence: References provided for issues outside their scope (Kristen's review)

authentic_signals: Specific project details (plaster type, tile, auto-fill)
Varied writing styles and emotional tones

Detailed complaint narratives with timelines and outcomes
complaint_patterns: Failure to maintain pool water quality (green pools)

reviews.text:
Prior to hiring Cox Pool Services to remodel our pool, we researched the competition and compared quotes from six vendors offering similar product.
We went from white plaster to "Tahoe blue" mini pebbles with new tile and handrail. The work crews were fast and professional. They cleaned up construction mess after each phase of the project.
We are happy with the outcome and would highly recommend Cox Pool Services.
reviews.author: Oleg Reztsov

reviews.text: We have used Cox Pool Service for over 10 years and they have been so helpful. If something is wrong, I usually contact them and they are quick to attend to the problem. At one time, lighting fried our pump and electrical pad and George helped us repair and rebuild our system. If he isn’t able to tend to the issue, he has given us reliable references that have also been so efficient to work with. We will continue to use their services for as long as we own a pool.
reviews.author: Kristen Pratt

reviews.text: Always look at reviews and the responses from the company. They paint a good picture of what you’re about to deal with. I wish I would have done that. Lesson learned. I will never use this company again. And yes Dawn knows I am a customer. They charged me for work that did not fix my pool and then left me in a position to have major damage during the freeze. Luckily I had another pool company come out and fix the problem. If you ever talk to Dawn you’ll see how rude she is. Just look at all her responses where the customer is wrong and she is right. I hope she changes that given she’s a small business owner and should know better.
reviews.author: Brenda Gruebmeyer

reviews.text:
Engaged Cox Pool Service for weekly maintenance & service in January 2021 thinking their slogan of "All you need to do is swim" was authentic.  Bottom line is my pool was not inhabitable for the first 8 weeks of summer.  Issues became worse & worse over time & there was always an excuse from them & a complete lack of responsibility. I paid $ 200+/- per month with understanding my pool would be cared for & all I need to do was enjoy it...such a sham.  Pictures below are from the day I terminated our agreement & from 3 weeks after.

Additional information based on owner response: actual billed amounts for the 6 months:
February: $ 173.20
March: $ 216.50
April: $ 303.10
May: $ 216.50
June: $ 380.89
Total: $ 1290.19
Average: $ 215.03
reviews.author: Bart Glancy

reviews.text: We bought a lake property with an existing pool. We needed help getting quite a few things repaired and winterized. They also added an auto fill to the pool since we are not there on a daily basis. They did a great job, in a timely manner, and for a great price.  I highly recommend them! We were very satisfied with their work and staff!
reviews.author: Julia Cearley

reviews.text: Since Cox Pool wanted to add my name to a previous dispute I feel compelled to respond. We did in fact get their name from the previous owners. Cox wrote below that they serviced the filter and then came back to do it a second time at which time the paint was discovered. My question would be why wasn't the paint seen on the first go around considering the house had been painted MONTHS previously. It wasn't your service tech who brought to your attention the pressure issue or the green reoccurrence issues it was me. Nothing would have  changed had I not reached out because each week he would come and the so would the algae.
reviews.author: Debra N

reviews.text:
My pool turned green in the 3 months I received service. I told them something was up and they said they're doing everything. I switched companies and the first cleaning with another company my pool was back to normal in a day.

I have invoices for cox pool services
reviews.author: zabin bhaidani

reviews.text: Cox Pool Service was very reliable, dependable, and did the job in a good timeframe.  I would recommend.  The "storm" put a stress on all the pool companies in our area and Cox Pool Service came thru.!
reviews.author: Jeff Kriz
